integrity: All claimed constants arise from finite exact Pisano-cycle arithmetic; the infinite statement is supported by a direct inclusion-exclusion proof. Computation provides corroboration, not a certificate of infinite cases.
scientific_limitations: The two-term expansion applies only when the Fibonacci index-window length is a multiple of the Pisano period. The implied constant can depend on fixed k and modulus m. A fixed-weight conditional proportion is not an ordinary natural density among all integers.
title: Two-term residue distributions on fixed-weight Zeckendorf slices
